# neon1

> neon1 is a one-person technology practice: cloud and AI engineering, business automation, networks, and cameras.

neon1 is the DBA of neon1 LLC, run by Pradeep Tathineni. Work is remote, on site within about 30 miles of Queens, NY, or over a secure temporary connection. Contact: hello@neon1.tech, +1 424-326-3661, or the form at https://neon1.tech/#contact.

- [Home page](https://neon1.tech/): services, process, client work, tools, and questions
- [Knowledge center](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/): every public document below, most with a PDF to download
- [Blog](https://neon1.tech/blog/): posts on local businesses' questions, the whats and whys of neon1, and lessons from its open repositories ([RSS](https://neon1.tech/blog/feed.xml))
- Source for these documents: https://github.com/neon1llc/neon1-corpus (CC BY-ND 4.0)

## Company

- [About neon1](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/about/): A one-person technology practice in New York that leaves people better off with their tech than they were before.
- [How neon1 is built](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/architecture/): Diagrams of the website, the 1NEON portal, Neo, and how a change reaches them.
- [Capability statement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/capabilities/): neon1 on one page for a buyer, partner, or procurement office: what it does, how it differs, work it has delivered, and the company's details.
- [Charter](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/charter/): What neon1 is for, who it serves first, the values it works by, and what it leaves to others.
- [Contact](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/contact/): How to reach neon1, when, and what the first call covers.
- [Glossary](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/glossary/): The names and technical terms used across neon1's documents, each in a sentence or two.
- [How neon1.tech works](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/how-it-works/): A plain walk through every part of neon1.tech: the page and its sections, the rain, the white rabbit, the Knowledge Center, the contact form, Neo, the 1NEON portal and its demo, sample, and guided walkthroughs, and how a change goes live.
- [Mission and promise](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/mission/): Why neon1 exists, what it does, and the five things every client can count on, on one page.
- [The names](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/names/): Where neon1, its slogan and its products get their names.
- [How a project runs](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/process/): Listen, propose, decide, build and hand over.
- [State registration](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/registration/): neon1 LLC's public record with the New York Department of State: its ID, status, filings, registered agent, and assumed name, and how to check the live record yourself.
- [Where I learn from](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/company/sources/): The standards bodies, government guides, and practitioners whose published work shapes how neon1 works, grouped by topic, with what each one is for.

## How I work

- [Writing](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/writing/): How everything neon1 writes is written, from policies and proposals to READMEs, commit messages, code comments, and interface text.
- [Development](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/development/): The main development standard for neon1: the principles in priority order, what each word means, how work moves from idea to release, and where the detailed rules live.
- [Operating principles](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/operating-principles/): The habits behind every neon1 engagement, and what each one means in practice.
- [Discovery and delivery](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/discovery-and-delivery/): How a neon1 project moves from your problem to a result you can run, step by step.
- [Version control](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/version-control/): How neon1 uses git: branch names, commit messages, merges, protected branches, and the history rules, and which safeguards production and client data require.
- [Versioning and releases](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/versioning/): How neon1 numbers releases of code (vX.Y.Z) and editions of documents (X.Y), when each number goes up, and how tags, changelogs, and package files stay in agreement.
- [Code style](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/code-style/): How neon1 code reads: names, comments, file headers, formatting, and layout, in every language and configuration format.
- [Testing and review](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/testing-and-review/): What neon1 tests, how changes are checked and reviewed before they ship, and what done means.
- [Documentation](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/documentation/): The documents every neon1 project keeps and how they stay true, and how the documents in this Knowledge Center are built, dated, shared, and credited.
- [Security and data](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/security-and-data/): How neon1 handles your accounts, access, and information, and the baseline every project starts from.
- [Design and accessibility](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/design-and-accessibility/): How neon1 designs interfaces and documents for any device and for people using assistive technology.
- [Technology decisions](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/technology-decisions/): How neon1 chooses tools and architecture, counts the full cost, and checks licenses.
- [Reliability and recovery](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/reliability-and-recovery/): How neon1 sets service targets, plans for failure, and tests that backups restore.
- [AI quality and oversight](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/ai-quality/): When neon1 uses AI, how it's tested before anyone relies on it, and where a person stays in charge.
- [Measurement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/measurement/): How neon1 defines success with you, measures it, and reports what the numbers can and can't show.
- [Customers](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/customers/): Who neon1 works with, how the work differs from households to enterprises, and when it declines work.
- [Partners](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/partners/): How neon1 works with other firms, vendors, and referrals, and how responsibilities and fees are disclosed.
- [Outreach and claims](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/standards/outreach/): How neon1 finds clients and talks about its work, and the sales tactics it doesn't use.

## Case studies

- [Answers in seconds, with sources](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/answers-in-seconds/): Staff spent minutes hunting through Microsoft 365, or interrupted a senior colleague.
- [Intake, out of the shared inbox](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/intake-out-of-the-inbox/): Intake ran through one inbox, with staff chasing documents and retyping them.
- [Two offices off local servers](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/two-offices-off-local-servers/): The app, database, and files lived on two local servers both offices relied on.
- [Security for non-security people](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/security-for-non-security-people/): People knew they were exposed online, but not where to start.
- [From cameras to Grandma's email](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/cameras-to-grandmas-email/): A house with no cameras, and passwords reused everywhere.
- [Where neon1 started](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/case-studies/where-neon1-started/): A grade school wanted real STEM tools on a small budget.

## Products

- [1NEON](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/1neon/): The neon1 client portal that comes with a client engagement, where each project runs from the first call to handover.
- [AWS CLIP](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/aws-clip/): AWS CLI Plus: account guards and approval checks around the AWS CLI, for people who juggle several AWS profiles.
- [DeployOps](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/deploy-ops/): Cloud automation, bundled: pipelines for infrastructure and applications on any major cloud.
- [Home Is Where the Smart Is](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/home-is-where-the-smart-is/): A household tech handbook for the person who looks after a family's devices and accounts.
- [Phish Out of Water](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/phish-out-of-water/): A security awareness session kit: slides, hands-on exercises, and a one-page takeaway.
- [Ready, Secure, Go](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/ready-secure-go/): Security readiness for every space, in plain language.
- [SOC It 2 Me](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/soc-it-2-me/): Hands-on SOC 2 readiness training for small and growing companies.
- [There Are No Incidents](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/there-are-no-incidents/): Incident response training for small businesses: a runbook, playbooks, tabletop exercises, and templates.
- [You Have 20 Seconds To Comply](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/products/you-have-20-seconds-to-comply/): Plain-language compliance guides and training for small businesses, from HIPAA and GxP to PCI DSS, privacy, and accessibility.

- [Where else to get help](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/landscape/where-else-to-get-help/): The other places a small business or household can get technology help, who each one suits, and when they'd serve you better than neon1.

## Templates

- [Business associate agreement request](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/baa-request/): The short questionnaire that tells us whether a project involves health information, and if so, what the business associate agreement needs to cover.
- [Business associate agreement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/business-associate-agreement/): An example HIPAA business associate agreement with neon1 LLC as the business associate, modeled on the HHS sample provisions.
- [Care plan](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/care-plan/): The monthly agreement for ongoing care after a project: what's looked after, what's included each month, how fast I respond, what it costs, and how it ends.
- [Decision review](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/decision-review/): A two-page written review of one technology decision: the situation, the options with their costs, a recommendation, and the next step.
- [Partner responsibilities](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/partner-responsibilities/): Who does what when neon1 works alongside another firm: selling, building, support, billing, data, insurance, and exit.
- [Proposal](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/proposal/): The proposal neon1 sends after discovery: your problem, the result, the options with what's in and out and honest hours, what each of us will do, price, and acceptance.
- [Services agreement](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/templates/services-agreement/): The short agreement a client and neon1 sign once, before any paid work: how proposals become agreed work, payment, changes, ownership, confidentiality, limits, and ending.

## Forms

- [Change request](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/change-request/): How a change to agreed scope is written down, priced, and approved before any work happens.
- [Discovery and outcome record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/discovery/): What's learned about one real task before a solution is proposed: steps, baseline, desired result, and options.
- [Incident and restore record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/incident-and-restore/): A timestamped record of an interruption or restore test, what was affected, what was done, and what changes next.
- [Intake](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/intake/): The first record of a possible project: the problem, who's involved, and whether it's a fit.
- [Metric record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/metric-record/): The exact definition of one measure: what counts, the formula, the source, the baseline, and the target.
- [Publication permission record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/publication-permission/): Your specific permission before anything about your project is published.
- [Release and handover record](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/release-and-handover/): The checklist that closes a project: acceptance, ownership, recovery, training, access removal, and follow-up.
- [Service and recovery profile](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/service-and-recovery-profile/): What a running service must do, how it's measured, who supports it, and how it comes back after a failure.
- [Tool and architecture decision](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/forms/tool-decision/): A short record of a technology choice: the problem, the options, the evidence, the cost, and the way out.

- [Proposal, filled in](https://neon1.tech/knowledge/examples/proposal/): A complete neon1 proposal for a fictional physical therapy practice's intake project. (fictional example)
